title: AI layer, compilation and repair
question: Do compiled-plan replay and bounded repair reduce the cost per verified task without false successes?

options.description: LLM discovery, then a compiled plan replayed without an LLM, bounded repair

evidence.note: compiled replay and silent drift, fake model
three real models, compiled replay and silent drift

notes: Fake provider first for contracts and budgets, then real models with a cost cap declared per campaign. On October 9, 2026: the primary metric becomes model spend alone (model-usd-per-1k-verified), the only one the lane measures; machine time remains secondary. The false-success-count gate, defined on the negative actionability variants, does not apply to this lane: an AI cell fails as soon as a run declares a success that the oracle refutes, so oracle-exact carries this contract. Tokens and spend are counted by the provider: the decision is made in local-dev.
